g.text: 1. Power Supply: +3.3V from ESP32-S3. Quiescent DC bias = 1.65V (mid-supply).

g.desc: 1. Power Supply: +3.3V from ESP32-S3. Quiescent DC bias = 1.65V (mid-supply).

g.text: 2. Microphone Bias: R1 (10k) provides JFET capsule power from +3.3V.

g.desc: 2. Microphone Bias: R1 (10k) provides JFET capsule power from +3.3V.

g.text: 5. Output Low-pass / Anti-Aliasing Filter: fc = 1 / (2*pi*R6*C4) = 15.9 kHz.

g.desc: 5. Output Low-pass / Anti-Aliasing Filter: fc = 1 / (2*pi*R6*C4) = 15.9 kHz.

g.text: 6. NOTE ON C2 (10uF): In the original prompt ASCII, C2 was drawn across R3 at Pin 3.
